chunks: Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام used to prostrate after he prayed, and he would not raise his head until the day had risen high.

key_terms.بَعْدَ: After; shows that this prostration occurred following salat (prayer).
key_terms.رَأْسَهُ: His head; the head remained lowered in prostration.
key_terms.يَرْفَعُ: He raises; here it refers to lifting his head from sajdah.
key_terms.يَسْجُدُ: He prostrates; indicates the act of sajdah.
key_terms.يُصَلِّي: He prays; refers to completing salat (prayer).
key_terms.ٱلنَّهَارُ: The day; indicates that the prostration continued until the daytime had advanced.

ai.seo_question: How did Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام perform sajdah after salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This report describes the devotional practice of Imam Musa ibn Ja'far عليهما السلام of remaining in sajdah for a long period after salat (prayer). It highlights his deep humility, worship, and gratitude before Allah.
